sources.title: Large Language Diffusion Models
sources.review_notes: All 33 pages reviewed against page renders by three reviewer agents (pages 1-9, 10-22, 23-33; reports in reports/review-pages-*.md): equations (1)-(16) transcribed from the authors' TeX and compared with high-resolution crops; Algorithms 1-5 cropped and transcribed line by line; Figures 1-5 boxed as single crops with edges checked; Tables 1-2, 4-12, 15-19 transcribed cell by cell (Tables 18-19 also compared programmatically with the PDF text layer and the TeX); Tables 3, 13, 14 kept as images with transcriptions; 125 references checked in order against the bibliography. Remaining verifier diagnostics are LaTeX-notation differences (maths, U+2212 minus, powers of ten, equation tags), numbers repeated in transcriptions or merged cells, and glued table cells in the second parser, adjudicated per page.

navigation.heading: Abstract
navigation.purpose: One-paragraph summary

navigation.heading: 1 Introduction
navigation.purpose: Generative-modelling principle (1) vs autoregressive factorisation (2); claim that scalability, in-context learning and instruction following come from (1), not (2); reversal curse; contributions [equations (1)-(2); figure-1]

navigation.heading: 2 Approach
navigation.purpose: Overview of the probabilistic formulation, pre-training, SFT and inference (Figure 2) [figure-2]

navigation.heading: 2.1 Probabilistic Formulation
navigation.purpose: Forward masking process, mask predictor, masked cross-entropy loss with 1/t weight (3), upper bound on negative log-likelihood (4), contrast with BERT fixed ratio and MaskGIT (no 1/t) [equations (3)-(4)]

navigation.heading: 2.2 Pre-training
navigation.purpose: Transformer without causal mask, 1B/8B variants, vanilla MHA (no KV cache), 2.3T tokens, 4096 length, 0.13M H800 GPU hours, 1% random-length data, Warmup-Stable-Decay schedule (4e-4 -> 1e-4 -> 1e-5), AdamW wd 0.1, batch 1280

navigation.heading: 2.3 Supervised Fine-Tuning
navigation.purpose: Prompt kept unmasked, response masked, SFT loss (5); 4.5M pairs, |EOS| padding treated as a normal token, 3 epochs, lr 2.5e-5 [equations (5)]

navigation.heading: 2.4 Inference
navigation.purpose: Reverse sampling from a fully masked response, steps and generation length as hyperparameters, remask s/t of predicted tokens, low-confidence remasking, autoregressive / block-diffusion sampling, low-variance conditional likelihood estimator (6) [equations (6)]

navigation.heading: 3 Experiments
navigation.purpose: Evaluation overview

navigation.heading: 3.1 Scalability of LLaDA on Language Tasks
navigation.purpose: Figure 3 (six benchmarks vs FLOPs, LLaDA vs own ARM baselines, 1e20-1e23 FLOPs), comparison with Nie et al. 16x compute claim [figure-3]

navigation.heading: 3.2 Benchmark Results
navigation.purpose: Table 1 (pre-trained LLaDA 8B Base vs LLaMA3/LLaMA2/Qwen/Mistral/Deepseek), Table 2 (post-trained, SFT only), data-leakage check, block-diffusion scores 78.6 GSM8K / 42.2 Math for Instruct [table-1, table-2]

navigation.heading: 3.3 Reversal Reasoning and Analyses
navigation.purpose: Reversal poem completion (496 Chinese poem pairs), Table 4 (forward vs reversal: GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-7B, LLaDA-8B), pointers to sampling ablations, efficiency, CFG [table-4]

navigation.heading: 3.4 Case Studies
navigation.purpose: Table 3 (sampling-process visualisation and multi-round dialogue) [table-3]

navigation.heading: 4 Related Work
navigation.purpose: Continuous text diffusion, discrete diffusion (Austin et al., Lou et al., Shi et al., Sahoo et al., Ou et al.), scaling laws of MDMs (Nie et al. [27]), adapting ARMs (Gong et al. [72]), a concurrent closed-source diffusion code model [73], image and protein MDMs, sampling acceleration

navigation.heading: 5 Conclusion and Discussion
navigation.purpose: Summary, limitations (fixed generation length, no KV cache, ARM baseline not scaled to the same compute, no RL alignment), future work
